nodes.name: Wood delignification and aerogel formation
nodes.procedure: The natural balsa wood was cut into one piece of 20 mm × 20 mm. The natural balsa wood was boiled under the mixed solution of 100 g L⁻¹ NaOH/50 g L⁻¹ Na₂SO₃ for 10 h, and then washed twice with hot deionized water to remove the solution on the surface of balsa wood. The washed balsa wood was treated by 8 wt% NaOH at 80°C for 8 h and then by 85 g L⁻¹ H₂O₂ at 60°C for 1 h for removing partial lignin and hemicellulose, following being washed three times with deionized water. The formed whitened balsa wood was rapidly frozen at -20°C overnight and then lyophilized to obtain the wood aerogel that consists of main cellulose.

nodes.name: Electroless NiMoP plating on wood aerogel
nodes.procedure: The conductive NiMoP alloys were plated on the surface of wood aerogel and its microchannels. The wood aerogel was soaked in a reducing solution of 5 g L⁻¹ NaBH₄ and 2 g L⁻¹ NaOH at room temperature for 20 min. Then, the wood aerogel for loading NaBH₄ and NaOH was put in a plating solution to achieve the activation and electroless plating in one bath. The plating solution includes 30 g L⁻¹ NiSO₄·6H₂O, 0.8 g L⁻¹ Na₂MoO₄·2H₂O (called as Mo-8), 0.15 g L⁻¹ CH₃COONa, 25 g L⁻¹ NaH₂PO₂·H₂O and 30 g L⁻¹ C₆H₅Na₃O₇·2H₂O. The pH was adjusted to 9.5 with NH₃·H₂O. The wood aerogel was immersed in the above plating solution for 1 h at 75°C.

nodes.name: S,P-(Ni,Mo,Fe)OOH formation by etching
nodes.procedure: Through a simple one-step method, the activating solutions including 35 g L⁻¹ Fe(NO₃)₃·9H₂O and 5 g L⁻¹ Na₂S₂O₃·5H₂O were used to etch NiMoP on wood aerogel for 2 min. The as-prepared layered S,P-(Ni,Mo,Fe)OOH/NiMoP/wood aerogel catalyst were then dried under vacuum at 60°C for 12 h.
